hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: For each position i, count occurrences of nums[i] at indices j such that i - j >= k.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Maintain a frequency tally of elements that fall into the valid delayed window.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Add nums[i - k] into the frequency counter before querying the count for index i.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

def delayedCount(nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(nums)
    res = [0] * n
    freq = Counter()
    for i in range(n):
        if i >= k:
            freq[nums[i - k]] += 1
        res[i] = freq[nums[i]]
    return res
```
